## 🌡️ MARKET ATMOSPHERE

**1. Global Risk Regime?**
NEUTRAL. Breadth: 6/11 sectors positive. VXX (1W: +7.63% | 1M: +12.83%) ↑ rising | ABOVE TREND and SPY (1W: -1.16% | 1M: -1.48%) ↓ falling | BELOW TREND provide mixed signals alongside neutral credit (HYG (1W: -0.16% | 1M: +0.03%) → flat | CORRECTION), supporting a neutral read.

**2. Primary Risk Drivers?**
Volatility creeping: VXX (1W: +7.63% | 1M: +12.83%) ↑ rising | ABOVE TREND. Energy rally driving risk-on flows: BNO (1W: +15.60% | 1M: +24.36%) ↑ rising | ABOVE TREND and XLE (1W: +2.41% | 1M: +12.27%) ↑ rising | ABOVE TREND. Credit and equities-bonds ratios flat (HYG/LQD and SPY/TLT neutral), keeping regime balanced.

**3. Financial Conditions Signal?**
Neutral overall: TLT (1W: -0.52% | 1M: +3.35%) → flat | CORRECTION and HYG (1W: -0.16% | 1M: +0.03%) → flat | CORRECTION, while SPY (1W: -1.16% | 1M: -1.48%) ↓ falling | BELOW TREND implies modest tightening in equity risk but no systemic stress.

## 📈 EQUITIES & FLOWS

**4. Sector Leadership?**
Energy leading: XLE (1W: +2.41% | 1M: +12.27%) ↑ rising | ABOVE TREND and BNO (1W: +15.60% | 1M: +24.36%) ↑ rising | ABOVE TREND. Tech weak: XLK (1W: -2.22% | 1M: -3.73%) ↓ falling | BELOW TREND; Financials also soft: XLF (1W: -0.71% | 1M: -4.68%) ↓ falling | BELOW TREND. Style: mixed / no clear leadership.

**5. US vs Global?**
US lagging modestly but steadier: SPY (1W: -1.16% | 1M: -1.48%) ↓ falling | BELOW TREND versus EM weakness — EEM (1W: -6.73% | 1M: -0.39%) ↓ falling | BELOW TREND and China FXI (1W: -5.75% | 1M: -7.56%) ↓ falling | BELOW TREND. Japan shows divergence/correction (EWJ 1W: -4.16% | 1M: +3.14% → CORRECTION) indicating patchy global internals.

**6. Speculative Appetite?**
Mixed: ARKK (1W: +1.89% | 1M: +0.77%) ↑ rising | ABOVE TREND and IBIT (1W: +5.63% | 1M: -6.29%) ↑ rising | RECOVERY show pockets of risk-on, while small caps IWM (1W: -1.07% | 1M: -0.16%) ↓ falling | BELOW TREND are soft.

## 🛢️ REAL ECONOMY

**7. Commodities Theme?**
Commodity strength concentrated in oil: USO (1W: +14.84% | 1M: +21.55%) ↑ rising | ABOVE TREND and UGA (1W: +12.16% | 1M: +21.95%) ↑ rising | ABOVE TREND; copper CPER (1W: -2.20% | 1M: +0.25%) ↓ falling | CORRECTION shows less industrial conviction. Gold GLD (1W: -0.34% | 1M: +10.46%) → flat | CORRECTION — metal haven bid intact month-to-date.

**8. Energy Trend?**
Oil and energy ETFs: XLE (1W: +2.41% | 1M: +12.27%) ↑ rising | ABOVE TREND; BNO (1W: +15.60% | 1M: +24.36%) ↑ rising | ABOVE TREND. Nat gas mixed: UNG (1W: +1.55% | 1M: -7.24%) ↑ rising | RECOVERY — watch volatility.

## 🧭 STRATEGY

**9. Trend Confirmation?**
Confirmed: Energy strength across XLE (1W: +2.41% | 1M: +12.27%) ABOVE TREND, BNO (1W: +15.60% | 1M: +24.36%) ABOVE TREND, and broad sector breadth at 6/11. Divergences are present but limited (many CORRECTION/RECOVERY signals: TLT (1W: -0.52% | 1M: +3.35%) → CORRECTION, GLD (1W: -0.34% | 1M: +10.46%) → CORRECTION) — classify as minor divergence, not a regime break.

**10. Portfolio Direction?**
Favor exposure to energy and select real assets given XLE (1W: +2.41% | 1M: +12.27%) ABOVE TREND and BNO (1W: +15.60% | 1M: +24.36%) ABOVE TREND; reduce exposure to weak cyclical pockets in Financials XLF (1W: -0.71% | 1M: -4.68%) BELOW TREND and broad Tech weakness XLK (1W: -2.22% | 1M: -3.73%) BELOW TREND. Monitor volatility via VXX (1W: +7.63% | 1M: +12.83%) ↑ rising and China risk FXI (1W: -5.75% | 1M: -7.56%) ↓ falling.

## 🔮 NEXT WEEK OUTLOOK

**11. Sectors to Watch?**
BULLISH: Energy — XLE (1W: +2.41% | 1M: +12.27%) ABOVE TREND and BNO (1W: +15.60% | 1M: +24.36%) ABOVE TREND if oil momentum continues. BEARISH: Financials XLF (1W: -0.71% | 1M: -4.68%) BELOW TREND and Consumer Discretionary XLY (1W: -0.60% | 1M: -4.57%) BELOW TREND on recent weakness.

**12. Commodities to Watch?**
BULLISH: Crude oil ETFs USO (1W: +14.84% | 1M: +21.55%) ABOVE TREND and BNO (1W: +15.60% | 1M: +24.36%) ABOVE TREND. BEARISH/MONITOR: Silver SLV (1W: -5.87% | 1M: +4.00%) ↓ falling | CORRECTION and nat gas UNG (1W: +1.55% | 1M: -7.24%) ↑ rising | RECOVERY — metals mixed.

**13. Key Levels?**
VXX (1W: +7.63% | 1M: +12.83%) ABOVE TREND — watch ~20 as a volatility sentinel; HYG (1W: -0.16% | 1M: +0.03%) CORRECTION and LQD (1W: -0.27% | 1M: +1.17%) CORRECTION — monitor HYG/LQD for credit stress; XLK (1W: -2.22% | 1M: -3.73%) BELOW TREND — watch monthly support for tech leadership pivot.

## 📝 EXECUTIVE SUMMARY

NEUTRAL. Breadth: 6/11 sectors positive. Energy showing strength: XLE (1W: +2.41% | 1M: +12.27%) ABOVE TREND and BNO (1W: +15.60% | 1M: +24.36%) ABOVE TREND. Key risk: rising volatility VXX (1W: +7.63% | 1M: +12.83%) ABOVE TREND and China weakness FXI (1W: -5.75% | 1M: -7.56%) BELOW TREND to monitor.
